verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a generative video platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Runway only as a cloud-based platform reached through a hosted HTTP API with credit billing (runway-docs-37, runway-docs-5, runway-docs-14), and contains no documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment. A community user explicitly wishing for a version that runs on their own GPUs (runway-comm-6) does not count as a product capability.
